{{alias}}( x, n )
    Rounds a numeric value to the nearest multiple of 10^n using
    single-precision floating-point arithmetic.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.
    n: number
        Integer power of 10 specifying the decimal place to which to round.

    Returns
    -------
    y: number
        Rounded value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 3.1415926, -2 )
    1
    > y = {{alias}}( 3.1415926, 0 )
    1
    > y = {{alias}}( 123.456, 2 )
    100.0
    > y = {{alias}}( -2.5, 0 )
    -1
    > y = {{alias}}( -0.0, 0 )
    -0.0

    See Also
    --------
